topic: Blackbeard didn't back down from Shanks at Marineford; he'd already got what he came for
title: Blackbeard Wasn't Scared Of Shanks At Marineford
description: Everyone says Shanks scared Blackbeard off at Marineford. Chapter 580 says something different. Was it fear, or a man who already won?
comment: Shanks vs Blackbeard: who actually wins today? Pick one.

lines.text: Blackbeard didn't run from Shanks at Marineford.

shot.fallback: big bearded pirate facing a red haired pirate

lines.text: Everyone says the Red Hair arrived and the war just stopped. But look at who actually walked away.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate stepping onto a battlefield

lines.text: In chapter 580, Shanks turns to Blackbeard, and Blackbeard doesn't flinch.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate confronting a dark pirate

lines.text: He's satisfied with what he took, so he postpones the fight and leaves.

shot.fallback: large pirate laughing and walking away

lines.text: That isn't a man backing off from a stronger Emperor. That's a man who got what he came for.

shot.fallback: dark pirate with glowing quake power

lines.text: And what he came for was Whitebeard's power.
Here's the part I keep thinking about.

shot.fallback: calm pirate captain speaking to an admiral

lines.text: Shanks had fought Kaido the day before, and the Marines were stunned he arrived so fast.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate with scarred eye

lines.text: Blackbeard saw the same thing, and he still chose the exit.
People say he was scared. But a scared man doesn't call it postponing.
The war ended because Blackbeard's errand was finished, and Sengoku knew it.
Shanks didn't scare Blackbeard off Marineford. He just got there after Blackbeard had already won.
Blackbeard didn't run from Shanks at Marineford...

self_check.hook: Blackbeard and Shanks named in line 1
